source: Nexon 'Maplayer One Challenger World and Burning Events!' notice (v.272, news id 47305), Item Burning Plus section: stages, rewards, Weekly Hunting Mission and Boss Defeat Mission. Checked 2026-11-23; boss crests and stage rewards read from the notice 2026-11-27. Item Burning Plus missions and Challenge Crest records reset Thursday 00:00 UTC (Nexon).
weeklyNote: Weekly Hunting Mission: 2,000 monsters within 20 levels for 100 crests, up to 5 times a week.
bossCrestsNote: Boss Defeat Mission: only clears in a solo party count, and Practice Mode clears count (Nexon). Crest records reset every Thursday 00:00 UTC, so the tracker counts each boss once a week; the notice implies this but does not say it outright.
stageNote: Stage objectives can be done early, but a stage only completes after all earlier stages. Stage bosses must be beaten solo; Practice Mode counts, and so does a higher difficulty (Nexon).

stages.reward: 18★ armor and weapon, Unique armor Potential, 2 Challenger Keys
Heroic: Potential stats raised (armor, weapon), 2 Challenger Keys
stages.rewardInteractive: Interactive: scroll stats raised (armor, weapon), Unique weapon and Epic armor Bonus Potential, 2 Challenger Keys

stages.reward: Legendary hat Potential (main stat and cooldown lines can be changed once a day), 2 Challenger Keys
